name: View options
$family: Part of 'View controls' (the sort-options sibling is guidance-only → guidelines/view-controls-sort.md).
purpose: A view control that lets users select different presentation formats of the same content (e.g. list vs grid). A segmented toggle of label-buttons or icon-buttons; the active format is the selected segment.

props.name: type
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C6 -- no-bind:variants-axis. Structural variance (a different assembly, not a scaled param); routes to the VARIANTS axis (s136-D1). Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

props.name: state
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C1 -- no-bind:state-selector. A state enum selects among per-state token SETS (colour-semantic); per-state maps are the colour-spine lane's job (not yet migrated). Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

variants.name: icon
variants.use: Icon-only segments (44px) for the same formats.

tokens.$finding: (2026-06-20) Selected segment rebound to the inverting fill secondary/background/default + text/on-inverse (legible both modes), not the marginal tertiary/background/pressed (#767676) the meta binds. Selection via aria-pressed, not colour alone.

accessibility.role: Expose as a single-select group (radiogroup or toggle-button group with aria-pressed); only one format active at a time
accessibility.selected: Selected segment must not be conveyed by the dark fill alone — expose aria-pressed/aria-checked (1.4.1)
accessibility.iconOnly: Icon-only segments need accessible names (e.g. 'List view', 'Grid view')

antiPatterns: Conveying the active view by the dark fill alone (add aria-pressed/checked)
Leaving the segment border + selected icon on the deprecated tokens — rebind to form/border/default + icon/default-reverse (see tokenValidation)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS — segment surfaces/text migrated to tertiary/*; 2 deprecated tokens (clean rebinds).

depricateUsage.note: Segment surfaces use the live tertiary/background/* state set (selected = pressed #767676 dark fill + tertiary/text/pressed reverse). Only the border (high-contrast depricate) + the reverse icon on the selected segment are deprecated — both clean rebinds (form/border/default, icon/default-reverse). Same border pattern as Dropdown-native / Chip-delete / Pagination.
